verdict.rationale: Xero can be driven without its UI through official APIs, an OpenAPI spec with an OAuth 2.0 schema, the xero-node SDK and an official MCP server. Machine-to-machine (non-interactive) access, which is what CI needs, comes via Custom Connections, but the evidence describes that as a premium option limited to a single org. Standard OAuth 2.0 apps imply interactive consent, so unattended automation carries real caveats. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless documentation, M2M auth without the premium/single-org limitation, a CLI tool, and hands-on or independent corroboration of CI usage.
